data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, even if others choose 10—not an all-or-nothing deal. Each switch from 10 earns $8,000 extra now if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock may be only 100. This risks future income, not guaranteed recovery; intentions aren't binding, and other catches require recalculation. Fisher20/Fisher07, help recruit. Each fisher: what exact catch do you intend, and does it depend on others?
